description: This file defines a custom exception class 'LoanForeclosureException' used within the loan account domain of the Fineract project. It extends the 'AbstractPlatformDomainRuleException' to handle specific foreclosure-related errors.

classes.name: LoanForeclosureException
classes.description: A custom exception used to signify errors related to loan foreclosure in the system. It extends a domain-specific base exception to provide contextual error handling.

methods.name: LoanForeclosureException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with an error code, message, and optional user message arguments, passing these to the superclass.
